boxes.meaning: not really; not a proper X

english.meaning: not really; not a proper X
english.note: Use this when saying that someone or something is not really or properly an example of the noun, as in 唔係傻 ‘no fool’.

examples.english: I’m no expert, so I don’t want to say anything rash.
